title: Scoped Security Acceptance: SAML Bridge, Delegated RBAC, and HSM Recovery PRD
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD for the scoped security acceptance criteria covering three interdependent areas: SAML-based SSO bridging for federated customers, delegated RBAC model for operator and tenant separation, and KMS/HSM recovery and escrow procedures for Private deployments. This ticket clarifies scope changes requested by Security and Compliance during design review and surfaces the sign-off checklist for cross-functional approvals.
acceptance_criteria: SAML Bridge: SSO via SAML providers (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin) is end-to-end validated with signed assertions and SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows documented.
SAML Edge Cases: Assertion replay protection, audience/recipient checks, and attributes mapping validated; SAML metadata refresh and certificate rollover tested without downtime.

Delegated RBAC: Role model implemented with at least three tiers (Customer Admin, Customer Operator, Platform Operator). Platform Operator privileges are split into immutable subset for infra actions only.
SCIM/Provisioning: SCIM-based group sync and role provisioning verified in staging for Okta and Azure AD integrations, with mapping templates captured in Confluence.
Audit Logs: All auth/authz events, key operations, and operator actions are written to an append-only audit store, hashed daily, and exported to customer-configurable SIEM endpoints.
Tamper Evidence: Audit logs include integrity proofs (daily signing) and a documented process for proving log continuity during an investigation.
KMS/HSM Integration: Customer-managed keys are supported via KMS + HSM-backed exportable keys where allowed by the customer. Key creation, rotation, and destruction flows are tested end-to-end.
HSM Recovery & Escrow: Recovery procedure for HSM-backed keys (operator vs. customer initiated) is validated in lab, with a documented key-escrow workflow and time-to-recover SLAs.
Access Controls: Separation of duties enforced by RBAC and MFA for all key management actions; emergency-access (break glass) documented and rate-limited.
E2E Tests & Backups: Automated E2E tests for SSO flows, role enforcement, and key rotation run in CI nightly; backup and restore tests for key material completed quarterly in staging.
Performance: Enabling SAML/SCIM and audit shipping has <5% effect on p50 API latency in dedicated capacity benchmarks (measured against baseline runtime-1.20).
Compliance Evidence: A package with configuration snapshots, test results, signed audit proofs, and runbooks is prepared for each private deployment onboarding.
Docs & Runbooks: Operator runbooks (RBAC changes, key rotation, HSM recovery) and customer-facing onboarding docs are stored in Confluence and linked from the release notes.
